Name: Refined Alex
Author: Crisaius
Description:
[b]Refined Alex[/b] focuses on subtle refinement rather than redesign.
This mod enhances Alex’s portraits by improving linework, shading, and color balance, while preserving the original outfits, personality, and vanilla art direction.
The mod also includes optional character sprites designed to match the refined portraits. All visual changes are fully configurable, allowing players to customize the experience while keeping a faithful look.

[img]https://imgur.com/P4gmhQX.png[/img]

• Refined vanilla-style portraits for Alex.
• Refined beach and winter portraits, preserving the original outfits and mood.
• Optional [b]Alternative Eyes[/b] for portraits.
• Optional [b]custom character sprites[/b] for Alex.
• Clean, balanced colors and improved visual consistency.
• Fully configurable via Content Patcher.

﻿[img]https://imgur.com/zeLF08G.png[/img]

[b][color=#e69138]﻿1[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [b][color=#e69138][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url][/color][/b].
[b][color=#e69138]2[/color][/b]. Install the latest version of [b][color=#e69138][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color][/b].
[b][color=#e69138]3[/color][/b]. Extract this mod into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
[b][color=#e69138]4[/color][/b]. Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://imgur.com/kQkaEbs.png[/img]

This mod can be configured using [b]Content Patcher[/b].
Available options:
[list]
[*][b]Alternative Eyes[/b]
Enables an alternative eye style for Alex’s portraits.[/*]
[*][b]Character Sprites[/b]
Enables custom character sprites for Alex. When enabled, a matching spouse portrait furniture is also applied.[/*]
[/list]Configuration can be edited via [b]config.json[/b] or through [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b] (if installed).

[img]https://imgur.com/g03zHCI.png[/img]

This mod was created by [b]Crisaius[/b].
Some elements of the character sprite style were inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url] by [b]Poltergeister[/b].
